info.title: Zeima API
info.description: Sync, organizations and licensing for the Zeima desktop app. Errors are `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with a stable `code`.

get.summary: Readiness: the dependencies (Keycloak, the database) are reachable
Find the API and the sign-in issuer from the server URL

200.description: Where to sign in and where the API lives

issuer.description: OpenID Connect issuer; its /.well-known/openid-configuration lists the endpoints

clientId.description: Public OAuth client the desktop app signs in with

minClientVersion.description: Oldest desktop app version (major.minor.patch) this server works with

schema.description: Where to sign in and where the API lives

get.summary: The signed-in user and their organizations

parameters.name: x-org-id
parameters.description: Active organization; must be one of the user's orgs.

post.summary: Creates an organization; the caller becomes its owner
post.description: Sign in again (or refresh the token) afterwards: the organization appears in the token's groups.

get.summary: The organization, the caller's role and the seats in use

pending.description: Invitations not yet accepted; they count against the limit

delete.summary: Deletes the organization, its memberships and its shared workspace (the members' personal data stays)

get.summary: Members the caller may see: everyone for owners and admins, the own groups for managers, only themselves for members

patch.summary: Changes a member's role (owners only) or deactivates or reactivates their account
patch.description: Deactivating disables the person's Keycloak account, so they cannot sign in anywhere; their data is kept. It is refused for people who are in other organizations too (remove them from this one instead). The last owner cannot be demoted.

delete.summary: Removes a member from the organization (their account and their own data stay)

get.summary: Invitations that have not been accepted yet

post.description: Keycloak sends the invitation. The person gets the role when they sign in with the invited address, which must be verified. Only owners can invite admins and managers. A pending invitation uses a seat.

delete.description: The person can still follow the link in the email, but gets no role and no access to organization data.

get.summary: Departments: all of them for owners and admins, the caller's own for everyone else

post.summary: Creates a department, optionally below another one

name.description: No slash; not starting with a space

delete.summary: Deletes a department and the departments below it

put.summary: Puts a member into a department

delete.summary: Takes a member out of a department

get.summary: The workspaces the caller can use
get.description: A second device finds the personal workspace here and syncs into it instead of creating another.

post.description: The first sync of a local workspace uploads it as the caller's personal workspace with this id.
Each change is merged field by field (last write wins by HLC). The response has one result per change, in order. Rejected changes are not applied; the reason says why.

get.description: Returns the merged state of rows changed after `cursor`, oldest first, across all workspaces the caller can see. Merge each field into the local row with the same rule as push. Pass the returned `cursor` next time; `more` says to ask again.

get.summary: The caller's plan, features and signed entitlement token

expiresAt.description: End of the paid period, unix seconds

token.description: Ed25519-signed token for offline checks; null on the Free plan

put.description: The token must be signed by a trusted issuer (`ENTITLEMENT_PUBLIC_KEYS`). It replaces the license for the same user or organization.

200.description: A license held by this server

expiresAt.description: End of the paid period, unix seconds

schema.description: A license held by this server

get.summary: The licenses installed on this server

expiresAt.description: End of the paid period, unix seconds

items.description: A license held by this server

post.summary: A purchase link for the caller
post.description: Open the link in a browser. The purchase turns into an entitlement when the payment provider confirms it.

portalUrl.description: Where the customer manages the subscription

post.description: Signed with the webhook secret (`X-Signature`, HMAC-SHA256 of the body). Not for clients.
